meta.name: demo-prep
meta.description: Prepare a customer demo or executive walkthrough around an evidenced outcome. Use before show-and-tell to rehearse the journey and prepare a fallback.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 彩排客户演示流程,并备好兜底方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果马上要向客户或高管做演示,担心现场出岔子。
copy.tagline_en: Rehearse the customer demo journey and prepare a fallback before showtime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to demo to a customer or exec and want a backup plan.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会围绕一个有证据支撑的结果帮你准备客户演示或高管走查:排练整条演示路径,并准备一套备用方案。它先读任务上下文契约和方法文档,能力缺失或检查未跑会如实说明。
howto.when: 在你做演示、客户走查之前触发;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前已脱敏的材料与范围,不重启 setup、发现或已答过的问题。

say.text: 帮我围绕一个有证据的结果排练这次客户演示的动线
say.note: 会先读上下文契约和方法文档

say.text: 顺便准备一套演示失败时的备用方案
用 @fde 当前的脱敏材料来准备,别再问我已经答过的
say.note: 复用已有的范围和材料

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude prepares a customer demo or executive walkthrough around an evidenced outcome: it rehearses the journey and prepares a fallback. It reads the task context contract and method first.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a show-and-tell; when called by @fde it reuses its current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup, discovery or answered questions.

say_en.text: Rehearse the journey for this customer demo around an evidenced outcome
say_en.note: Reads the contract and method first

say_en.text: Also prepare a fallback for the demo
say_en.note: Prepares a fallback per the method

say_en.text: Use @fde's current sanitized packet, don't re-ask answered questions
